title: Polynomial-time canonical serialization
statement: For every machine format $F$, there are a finite Turing machine $C$ over the Boolean alphabet and a natural number $d$ such that, on every Boolean input $\alpha$, $C$ halts within $d(|\alpha|+1)^d$ steps with output equal to the serialization, in format $F$, of the code decoded from $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: output is the serialization of the decoded code
